title: German registry for thoracic aortic pathologies
summary: In this study, different data (clinical, radiological, genetic) on thoracic aortic pathologies will be combined and analyzed.  The aim is to identify genetic risk factors in order to improve the treatment of such diseases.

interventions.name: Clinical, radiological and genetic data of thoracic aortic pathologies are prospectively collected and evaluated.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patient's ability to consent, confirmed diagnosis of acute aortic pathology (PAU, IMH, type Stanford B aortic dissection, aortic aneurysm) of the thoracic aorta (without involvement of the aortic arch or ascending aorta). The origin of the aortic pathology must be in the area of the thoracic aorta, but can also spread to the abdominal aorta or iliac arteries.
Exclusion criteria:
Inadequate anonymization, lack of informed consent from study participants, patients are not able to give consent, traumatic aortic pathology due to accident, data transfer outside the Heidelberg Portal for Medical Data Models (https://medical-data-models.org)
